description: Live run-tool E2E tool list for the Dialogic Tools extension (CLASS-B: wraps the third-party dialogic-godot/dialogic addon, installed into testbed/addons/dialogic by CI). Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py from the e2e-godot CI leg against a connected headless editor + a local gamedev-mcp-server. Each entry is one real assertion: a regression in the tool turns the CI leg red.
notes: No 'setup' scene is needed: every Dialogic tool authors/reads res:// RESOURCES (.dtl/.dch) by path, not scene nodes, so none resolves against EditorInterface.GetEditedSceneRoot(). The tools are ordered so add-text/get operate on resources the create tools just wrote. Because the addon IS installed in the testbed, the editor tools assert the Class-B happy path '"Installed":true'. 'expect' substrings are matched against godot-cli's compact --raw JSON (ReflectorNet serializes PascalCase property names, so the casing here is PascalCase).
